chapter_seo_title: The Psychiatric Ward: Li Huowang's Deceptively Quiet Day Out
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang enjoys a peaceful day in the hospital with his mother, watching TV and listening to guards debate marriage. The quiet before the storm.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 590: The Peaceful Psychiatric Ward
og_description: Amidst the mundane chatter of a hospital day, Li Huowang finds a moment of calm. But in the Dao-Twisted World, peace is the most dangerous illusion of all.
twitter_title: Ch. 590: The Silence is the Scariest Part
twitter_description: Just a mom, her son, and a debate about marriage in a psych ward. Don't get comfortable. #DaoGuiYiXian

lore_anchors.definition: A specific, high-security section of the psychiatric hospital, likely named after the larger metaphor of the ‘White Tower’ as a counterpart to the White Jade Capital.

A traditional Chinese festival marking the start of the New Year's countdown, typically on the 23rd or 24th of the twelfth lunar month, centered on sending the Kitchen God (Zao Jun) to report to heaven.
A specialized garment used to restrict patient movement in psychiatric facilities; seeing Li Huowang without one signals a massive drop in his perceived threat level.
